policyAndLimits: Exact legal history is bound to the reached six-field FEN. Private immutable contexts advance only by a legal move, reset counts after pawn moves/captures and preserve prior automatic fivefold/75-move termination with checkmate priority.

Current and announced defender claims are checked at every actual mating proof node. Optional attacker claims do not erase a win. Missing/malformed history remains unknown, not evidence that no repetition existed.

Only history-sensitive mating claims are requalified. Initial unique histories also replay the supplied candidate route cheaply, so a later loop cannot certify named/root support. Independently proved material/drawing resources are not blanket-discarded.

At most seven attacking moves/13 plies and one total65,536 legal-node budget across increasing distance attempts. Every defender move is covered. Short finishes enumerate all legal attacker moves; longer ones admit checks and bounded legally nominated quiet moves. Unsupported/exhausted searches abstain, not declare a draw.

A safe different route yields only generic Forcing Mate with fresh distance/evidence; stale named mechanisms, compound/comparison metadata and old alternative lines are removed. Actual immediate named mates remain terminal facts.

Mating self-interference is a defender concession, not the mover's mate. Repetition-sensitive concession support is conservatively withheld rather than reversed into a generic attacking claim. This does not reprove every named mechanism.

Played-mate neutralization also requires positive history qualification. A Bf5/Pd3 control is blind-proof=true/history-proof=unknown; that is NOT a demonstrated draw, loss of win, or safe best alternative.

Material and endgame kernels are not all made repetition-aware in this slice. No owner data, engine download, installed runtime, hosting or website was changed. These selected regression contracts are not global tactical accuracy.
